envelope.description: Wire managed daemon readiness, shutdown and watchdog

body.title: Wire managed daemon readiness, shutdown and watchdog
body.summary: Integrate inherited ready/drain/arm and public shutdown admission in the daemon and both dispatch modes. Preserve local-signal emergency behavior and legacy/Linux broker routes. Avoid enabling installed rollout until the controller and updater are wired.
acceptanceChecks: Public shutdown cannot bypass an update reservation
Admitted drains and local signals keep independent generation-bound deadlines, with no managed Mach broker call

tests.name: Managed watchdog arm has reserved capacity during a controller request burst
IPC and signal shutdown with no controller
Hung before shutdown reply and hung native close after watchdog readiness
Linux existing pidfd and watchdog suites
Hold a client connection open during managed server.close and confirm forced reap releases the supervisor guard and permits exactly one restart
Public RPC arm gets busy during update while an admitted drain and local signal preserve their watchdog path
